_status: DRAFT — NOT frozen. Defines the EXP002 condition set for pipeline development and smoke testing. experiments/exp002/config.frozen.json will supersede this before the real run; do not attribute results to this file.
design: 2-factor ablation (A = frame selection, B = prompt), evaluated per clip under every listed condition (paired).

A_frame_selection.A3: pixel + DOM fused keyframe selection (DOM influences which frames are sent)

B_prompt.B1: dual-path decision prompt (DOM evidence text lives here, under factor B)

_dropped.A2: DOM-mutation-only selection — excluded from the headline set; would need a selector not yet built.

generation_config._note: temperature is a controlled variable; repeats capture residual API non-determinism, not sampling spread.

evaluation._power: planning cell (p_disc=0.20, psi=0.85) reaches 0.94 at n=120 — see poc/results/power_analysis.json
